Lemma
[Invertibility of the linearized harmonic boundary operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0293 ↗ lem:chow-iv-linearized-harmonic-boundary-weak-solution ↗ lem:chow-iv-linearized-harmonic-boundary-regularity ↗ lem:chow-iv-linearized-harmonic-boundary-schauder 1. ch34:34.17\group Harmonic Maps with Boundary

The operator \[ U\longmapsto \bigl(\Delta U+\Rc (U),(\nabla _NU)_{\top }-\mathrm{II}(U)\bigr) \] from tangent-boundary $C^{2,\alpha }$ vector fields to $C^\alpha (TM)\times C^{1,\alpha }(T\partial M)$ is an isomorphism.
Proof

\sketch For smooth data, weak existence and regularity give a smooth solution. Approximate arbitrary Hölder data by smooth data. The Schauder estimate makes the associated solutions Cauchy in $C^{2,\alpha }$, so their limit solves the prescribed problem. The same estimate gives uniqueness and boundedness of the inverse.

□
